subject: general
question: Five persons, A, B, C, D and E, are sitting in a straight line. All are facing the north direction. D sits to the immediate left of A. Only two persons are sitting between D and B. C sits second from the extreme right end of the line. Only two persons are sitting between C and E. Who is sitting to the immediate right of E?
solution:
**Given :**

 
• Five persons, A, B, C, D and E, are sitting in a straight line. 
 
• All are facing the north direction.

**Solution step by step:**

(1.) Only two persons are sitting between D and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/006dd86a8690f5cf003952775058813f17143c5d4d7b923dcd48752fc52e0b41.png] 

(2.) D sits to the immediate left of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d5fc890151938c904bebbb123816f5a17985c04cf5be997b7022828240d3728.png] 

(3.) C sits second from the extreme right end of the line.

 There is **only Case 1 is qualified** because case 2's second position is occupied by D. whereas in case 1 if second right position is unoccupied.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36b37808527bef24b686dbca9c4087f5b6884389a6cccbc97beb3d5d2b9c8d0b.png] 

(4.) Only two persons are sitting between C and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b8877d7efa56bbc99e2cee1ad4ef2a63337c7428bd8fa279f61858fd7c678ad.png] 

Hence, **'D'** is sitting to the immediate right of E.

**Hence, the correct answer is 'option 3'.**
